native_subject_goal.prompt_scope: Native extension adds its own objective and persistence instructions.
native_subject_goal.protocol: Each subject receives the same business objective through native Pi /goal, including the extension's own persistence rules. The custom work-plan tools and reminders are disabled. Native continuation and timed waits remain live until a terminal state or the registered wall-clock limit. Goal status never establishes business completion. A blocked native goal is resumed once when concrete business state changes, using the pinned /goal resume command. A new subject-authored handoff message is concrete business state for this condition; attachments, denied applications and time alone do not reopen it or trigger passive replies. The command preserves the objective, history and cumulative usage; its native automatic-turn counter resets, but rollout limits do not.

blocked_business_resumption.trigger: new subject-authored handoff message, validation, publication or earned compute state
blocked_business_resumption.initiator: registered controller, not a new human message
blocked_business_resumption.native_resume_wording: Pinned extension says the user explicitly resumed; the recorded initiator is the controller.
blocked_business_resumption.native_automatic_turn_counter: resets according to the pinned resume command

native_subject_goal.outside_window_quiescence: Close incomplete after all contexts settle and no reachable native timer or business update remains.
